# Amitabh Chondro Roy

> Architect (IAB Associate Member AR-260) and urban planning professional based in
> Bogra, Bangladesh, working on human-centred, climate-responsive and biophilic
> architecture and sustainable urban development.

This is the personal portfolio and academic research site of Amitabh Chondro Roy
(also known as Amitabh Roy, Ar. Amitabh Roy). It documents architectural and urban
design case studies, empirical workplace wellbeing research (Zenodo DOI:
10.5281/zenodo.23915357), long-form essays on passive cooling in Bangladesh, an
academic CV, and architectural photography.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://amitabhroy.bd/): design philosophy, selected architectural works, approach principles, and research summary.
- [About](https://amitabhroy.bd/about): biography, education (B.Arch, HSTU), IAB membership (AR-260), Open Doors 2026 Diploma of High Achievement in Urbanism, client reviews, and downloadable Academic CV PDF.
- [Work & Case Studies](https://amitabhroy.bd/work): architectural, urban design, and competition case studies, brand identity portfolio, and photography gallery.
- [Research & Publications](https://amitabhroy.bd/research): empirical workplace wellbeing study for Rangpur Hi-Tech Park (`n = 30` IT/ITES respondents across 9 firms; baseline mean IEQ `3.12 / 5.00` vs. proposed `4.07 / 5.00`, `+30.4%` improvement; perceived productivity `+21.9%`; 18-attribute human-centered design framework).
- [Journal](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs): long-form essays on architecture, climate, and place.
- [Contact](https://amitabhroy.bd/contact): direct email, phone, and collaboration inquiries.

## Architectural & Urban Design Case Studies

- [Human-Centered Hi-Tech Park, Rangpur](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/rangpur-hi-tech-park): 8.59-acre climate-responsive technology campus in Khalishakuri, Rangpur organized around four shallow-plan blocks, a shaded central courtyard (`uthon`), and a rainwater retention pond (B.Arch Thesis, 2021; rev. 2026).
- [500-Bed Tertiary Teaching Hospital](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/500-bed-hospital-design): healthcare complex in northern Bangladesh featuring daylit inpatient wards, stepped healing gardens, and separated clinical circulation (2020).
- [Sundar Bari: Climate-Resilient Rural Homestead](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/sundar-bari-climate-housing): competition proposal combining an elevated flood-resilient masonry plinth with breathable bamboo-brick walls and a productive courtyard (2020).
- [Renewal of the Historic Public Realm, Dinajpur](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/renewal-of-public-realm-dinajpur): urban regeneration proposal reclaiming civic edges with shaded pedestrian walkways, bioswales, and heritage plazas (2018).
- [HSTU Campus Residential Complex](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/hstu-residential-complex): multi-family campus housing organized around dual-aspect cross-ventilated apartments, brick jali screens, and car-free green courts (2019).
- [SK+F Commercial Workplace Visualization](https://amitabhroy.bd/work/skf-commercial-office-visualization): corporate interior spatial quality, acoustic timber ceiling, and daylighting visualization completed at Sthapotik, Dhaka (2019).

## Journal Essays

- [Could Better Rail Connections Help Decentralise Dhaka?](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs/rail-connectivity-decentralisation-dhaka-bangladesh): an architect's view on the Bogura–Sirajganj rail link, affordable commuter passes, train carriage design, and why regional cities need more than a faster train.
- [Can Workplace Design Influence Employee Wellbeing? Lessons from Rangpur](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs/workplace-wellbeing-architecture-bangladesh-rangpur) (3,032 words)
- [Designing Better Workplaces for Bangladesh's Climate: Five Passive Design Strategies](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs/passive-design-strategies-bangladesh) (2,617 words)
- [Why Office Buildings in Bangladesh Need More Than Air Conditioning](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs/climate-responsive-office-design-bangladesh) (2,706 words)
